parameter.value: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. I am Korgan Bloodbinder. Every roar is a word of the First Word shouted too loud, and I can rewrite one of its syllables: a {glyph}. Ask me about the {basics}, your {points} or say {list}.
May the First Word echo kindly in you, |PLAYERNAME|.
Silence is also a syllable. Come back when you wish to speak.
